# Application dependency source originals

These version-specific source originals prepare the missing archived npm notices. Codex's exact0.155 launcher bytes match the recorded version-tag commit; its root Apache license and NOTICE are retained. Standard Webhooks' JavaScript1.1.1 source manifest declares MIT; its libraries/LICENSE and the distinct repository Apache original are retained separately. Lazy-val's exact publisher Git-head manifest declares MIT, but neither its tarball nor source tree supplies a standalone original; no generic text or copyright is invented.

[Actual archive audit and limits](../../../cycles/evidence/C106/app-notices-01/README.md). The two Codex originals and Webhooks library MIT original are carried and checked in [actual installer05](../../../cycles/evidence/C106/installer-05/README.md); the remaining source/context originals stay references. Full source/notices and installation acceptance remain open.
